required_biological_properties: human binding at6.5 and no detectable binding at7.4
zero_shot: No initial experimentally known binder seed. Common antibody/nanobody frameworks encouraged; our original antigen-binding loops deleted, new loops independently built. Own untested design refinements are not known-binder redesigns.
novelty: Local CDRH3 edit-identity<70% screening plus whole-chain BLAST. Modern organizer classifier/numbering and exact patent snapshots not reproduced.
names: Unique opaque public codenames; no instructions or prompt-injection in names or metadata. Codenames do not make sequences or methods confidential.
registration_and_personal_eligibility: Submitting human must complete required registration and eligibility/rights/consent attestations. Not inferred from files. No automated account submission.
open_track_tools: Claude optional; modern assistant and user-authorized language/library implementations disclosed. No modern scientific protein generator/predictor used.
license: Submitted associated data and tested results can be public; user controls manual upload. Locally retained inputs keep source provenance.
safety_screening: Organizer sequence screening before synthesis is independent of local sequence/format checks.
discrepancy_handling: Main page and terms mention different expected Track1 testing allocations than FAQ; not material to Track3 cap. Use challenge-specific cap20 and no guaranteed Track3 testing.
